name: Wati Message Delivery
script:
# Wati Message Delivery — Dashboard Chart Source
# Returns daily success / failure counts for the last 30 days.
# Called by the 'Wati Message Delivery' Dashboard Chart on the
# Wati Integration workspace.

from frappe.utils import add_days, nowdate
import frappe

from_date = add_days(nowdate(), -30)

rows = frappe.db.sql(
    """
    SELECT
        DATE(sent_at)                                              AS name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code = '200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS success,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status_code != '200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)    AS failed
    FROM `tabWati Message Log`
    WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL
      AND DATE(sent_at) >= %(from_date)s
    GROUP BY DATE(sent_at)
    ORDER BY DATE(sent_at) ASC
    """,
    {"from_date": from_date},
    as_dict=1,
)

labels    = [str(r["name"])    for r in rows]
success   = [r["success"]      for r in rows]
failed    = [r["failed"]       for r in rows]

chart = {
    "labels": labels,
    "datasets": [
        {"name": "Sent (200)",  "values": success, "chartType": "bar"},
        {"name": "Failed",      "values": failed,  "chartType": "bar"},
    ],
    "type": "bar",
    "colors": ["#28a745", "#dc3545"],
    "barOptions": {"stacked": 0},
}
